nodes.label: Business Idea
nodes.summary: Generating a business idea is a simple process of finding a real problem that people face and figuring out an easy way to solve it.
nodes.why: A registered name is something you can brand.

nodes.label: Brand identity
nodes.summary: Logo, colors, typography and voice guidelines every other service inherits.
nodes.why: The brand sets the look every page uses.

nodes.label: Website
nodes.summary: A fast, mobile-first site that turns visits into enquiries; the home base all traffic lands on.
nodes.why: The site gives every post and ad somewhere to send people.

nodes.label: Social & content
nodes.summary: Profiles, content system and branded creatives, published consistently on the platforms your customers use.
nodes.why: Organic posts show which messages win before ad money is spent.

nodes.label: Meta + Google Ads
nodes.summary: Paid campaigns that reach the right people now; ad budgets are paid separately to the platforms.
nodes.why: Ad data shows what people actually search for.

nodes.label: SEO
nodes.summary: Local and on-page SEO that brings free, compounding traffic over time.

nodes.label: Follow-up
nodes.summary: WhatsApp replies, reminders and reporting that turn enquiries into customers and customers into repeat business.
nodes.why: Repeat customers and referrals restart the cycle.
